programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer nabolaget
programme.desc: Token føler seg ensom fordi han er eneste rike barn i byen, og lokker andre velstående mennesker til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmtraileren
programme.desc: Alle barna i South Park er superspente på å se den første traileren for den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmen.

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Jimmy og Timmy blir medlemmer av gjengen The Crips, som de tror er en klubb for funksjonshemmede.

programme.title: South Park: Feitrumpe og pannekakehode
programme.desc: Cartman lager en J-Lo-fingerdukke til et arrangement som skal hylle latinamerikanere.

programme.title: South Park: Dum, bortskjemt hore-leketøy
programme.desc: Paris Hilton åpner butikk i South Park og forderver jentenes moral - bare Wendy holder fast på sine prinsipper.

programme.title: South Park: Agentbyrået
programme.desc: Som talentmanagere kan Cartman, Stan og Kenny innkassere 10 % av klientenes inntekter, men et annet byrå stjeler deres eneste klient.

programme.title: South Park: En million små fibre
programme.desc: Towelie skriver en bok som blir valgt ut til Oprahs bokklubb og blir en bestselger blant folk som vil overvinne avhengighet.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med toeren på pissoaret
programme.desc: Cartman tror han vet hvem som står bak angrepene 11. september.

programme.title: South Park: Momben
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park forbereder seg til et besøk av Hillary Clinton. Cartman mistenker at en muslimsk elev er involvert i et mulig terroristangrep.

programme.title: South Park: Mer drittproblemer
programme.desc: Randy slår verdensrekorden 'største bæsj', og den tidligere rekordinnehaveren Bono vil ha tilbake tronen. Men han har en mørk hemmelighet som kanskje kan hindre ham.

programme.title: South Park: Britneys nye stil
programme.desc: Mediesirkuset kommer til South Park når Britney gjemmer seg i den avsidesliggende fjellbyen. Guttene prøver å hjelpe den plagede popstjernen.

programme.title: South Park: Kina-problemet
programme.desc: Cartman blir forskrekket over den storslåtte OL-seremonien og ber Butters om hjelp til å konfrontere kineserne. Samtidig blir Stan og Kyle vitne til 'voldtekten' av Indiana Jones.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskepikker
programme.desc: Jimmi er rasende for at Cartmann prøver å ta æren for en vits som han fant på og som nå er blitt populær i hele landet. Men en sint Kanye West klarer ikke å forstå poenget.

programme.title: South Park: Døde kjendiser
programme.desc: Michael Jacksons spøkelse nekter å akseptere å måtte vandre heden og etterlater resten av de nylig avdøde berømtheter frustrert i Skjærsilden.

programme.title: South Park: Sexhjelpen
programme.desc: Kyle og Butters befinner seg midt blant Amerikas superkjendiser når de gjennomgår en behandling for sexavhengighet. Cartman og Stan er limt til Tiger Woods-kampen.

programme.title: South Park: Lattermaskinen
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt gjort narr av på The South Park Elementary Comedy Awards, bygger Germany en uovervinnerlig lattermaskin: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheten går likevel ikke altfor bra.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman finner kjærligheten
programme.desc: Cartman spiller matchmaker når en ny jente flytter til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Kravene heves
programme.desc: Cartman innrømmer endelig at han er feit og får umiddelbart en permobil.

programme.title: South Park: Hobbiten
programme.desc: Wendy prøver å pare en av sine venninner med Butters, men hun ender opp på kontoret til skolekuratoren.

programme.title: South Park: #Oppkok
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spill med lillebroren sin. Men da Ike vil ikke spille med ham mer, blir Kyle redd for at neste generasjon vil forbigå ham.

programme.title: South Park: Glade hologram
programme.desc: Cartman trender, mens resten av USA forbereder seg til det største juleprogrammet på tv noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Fabuløs og modig
programme.desc: Gutta viser Caitlyn Jenner sin enormt store respekt i det mest fabuløse og modige 'South Park'-avsnittet noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Trygt sted
programme.desc: Cartman er siste offer innen kroppsskam.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Den nye gutten i klassen overtaler Jesus til å kjempe mot Satan, i det endelige oppgjøret mellom godt og ondt. Cartman blir rasende når han oppdager at oppgjøret krasjer med bursdagsfesten hans.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans mor er en hore
programme.desc: Dr. Mephisto hjelper Cartman med å avsløre farens identitet, og alle mannlige innbyggere i South Park er aktuelle kandidater.

programme.title: South Park: Byen ved avgrunnens rand (tilbakeblikk)
programme.desc: Skolebussen krasjer i en snøstorm og blir stående på kanten av et stup.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny blir oppslukt av det siste nye fra Japan: Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Dø, hippie, dø
programme.desc: Cartman blir arrestert for å fange hippier, men når South Park blir oversvømmet av hippier, vender de seg til ham og hans uvanlige metoder for hippiefjerning.

programme.title: South Park: Barneskolemusikal
programme.desc: Musikalfeberen når South Park, og guttene må spille med eller miste popularitet.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: When resident Paul Brewer is killed, it's the second murder in a month at the exclusive gated community, Hillview Estates. With no leads on the killer, Steve goes undercover as Dr. Steve Brewer, a community resident.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Personal grievances get in the way of detective Harry Trumble's retirement party. Trumble never forgave Dr. Sloan for marrying his college sweetheart and dedicated his life to his work.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Dr. Sloan treats Amanda and Jesse to lunch to acknowledge Amanda's medical examiner investigation award. Unfortunately, their festivities are interrupted when a young man collapses in the hotel restaurant wearing only a bathrobe.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Jesse witnesses a car accident and rushes to help the beautiful victim, Chloe Marsden, who has stopped breathing. After a quick application of CPR, Chloe is revived and finds Jesse accompanying her to the hospital.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: To Steve, Jesse, and Amanda's embarrassment, Dr. Sloan rehearses with a swing band at BBQ Bob's as he prepares for a benefit dance for the children's unit at the hospital. But the mood quickly transforms into a tone of horror.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Steve meets up with his young protégé, Tommy Allen, but is ready to strangle him when he finds out that Tommy was involved in another brawl, this time at BBQ Bob's!

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: A ratings war sparks a wave of deaths across the big TV networks - a magician impales himself on a bed of spikes, and Dr Danger also turns up dead.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The seven remaining chefs are called down to the dining room to discover two ice dancers performing a routine. Chef Ramsay explains ice dancing can be romantic, just as dessert can be. For their challenge they must cook an extraordinary dessert.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: In the first challenge, the final six chefs break through a case, retrieving a random ingredient they will have to cook with. The second challenge has each chef cooking with the same four ingredients. The third challenge is a surf and turf challenge.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The five chefs compete in Chef Ramsay's Taste It, Now Make It challenge, recreating his intricate eggs Benedict dish. Later, the fish station struggles at dinner service, leaving the chef in charge of it in real danger of being sent home.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs undertake a tableside challenge, creating dishes for esteemed brigades acting as judges. Later, elimination surprises everyone, including Chef Ramsay.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Following emotional reunions with their proud parents, Chef Ramsay tasks the final two chefs with creating five meals in only 60 minutes, with the winner earning first pick for their brigade in the final challenge.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs go head-to-head for the final time, before the new executive chef at Gordon Ramsay's Hell's Kitchen at Caesar's Palace is announced.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: Young Guns Come Out Shooting
programme.desc: Eighteen aspiring chefs from across the country, 23-years-old or younger, begin the competition.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Both teams are put to the test as they take on their first dinner service preparing dinner for boxing legend Mike Tyson and racecar driver Kurt Busch.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: Come Hell or High Water!
programme.desc: The chefs must replicate the very first challenge in "Hell's Kitchen" history: breaking down squid perfectly for chef Ramsay; Gordon discovers the blue team has served up raw chicken during dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: Young Guns Going Big
programme.desc: The chefs must make brunch for 60 hungry Caesars Palace employees, fresh off the night shift; one chef takes the fall during the use of a punishment pass, earning the respect of both teams; dinner service leads some chefs to crack under the pressure.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: After a big shakeup during the last elimination, both teams must work together to decipher recipes written in emojis; one team has its best dinner service performance yet, while the other team struggles to find its groove.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: A Ramsay Birthday in Hell!
programme.desc: The chefs take on a new type of challenge when the restaurant is closed for chef Ramsay's daughter's 21st birthday party; one team rises to the occasion, while the other serves up its biggest disappointment thus far.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: If You Can't Stand the Heat...
programme.desc: The chefs go head-to-head, each cooking up a different international cuisine against a chef from the opposing team; Ramsay kicks a chef out of the kitchen.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The remaining chefs compete in a tag team relay race competition, in which they must cook entrées against the other team; five chefs face the first "Cook For Your Life" challenge of the season.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: A Game Show From Hell
programme.desc: One team struggles to work together on its dish; during a special charity dinner service, both teams make big mistakes, and one chef gets heated over who should be put on the chopping block.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: More Than a Sticky Situation
programme.desc: The chefs take on the blind taste test challenge with messy consequences; one team comes unglued during dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs jump back into the dating game on hkchefsonly.com, hoping to swipe right on the perfect match of ingredients for their dish; the stakes are high during a special steak night dinner service; one team struggles with overcooking its dish.

programme.desc: Al oppdager at Bert ikke er hans biologiske far.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 204
programme.desc: En gammel mann som har en uforklarlig stank, konsulterer doktor Ellingham; og den lokale radioverten, Caroline, har et alvorlig drikkeproblem.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 205
programme.desc: Martin undersøker Helen Pratt, men hun kollapser og dør. Mannen hennes, Phil, er sint på legen og gir ham skylden for konas død.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 206
programme.desc: Martins vanskelige foreldre kommer for å bo hos ham. Han har ikke sett dem på syv år, og er forvirret over hvorfor de plutselig skulle dukke opp nå.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 207
programme.desc: Mark Mylow planlegger å tilbringe sitt utdrikningslag i skogen med Al Large, men han blir bitt av en huggorm.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 208
programme.desc: Et medlem av Frelsesarmeen kommer til Portwenn for å prøve å finne en savnet kvinne. Danny ber sin motvillige kjæreste Louisa om flytte inn hos ham.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 301
programme.desc: Martin mistenker at Louisa kan ha anemi. Tante Joan blir tvunget til å motta behandling fra Martin etter at hun nesten kjørte på noen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 302
programme.desc: Bert Large forlater rørleggerfirmaet sitt til fordel for å drive en restaurant. Etter restaurantens åpning forekommer det flere tilfeller av matforgiftning.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 303
programme.desc: Et par og sønnen deres flytter inn ved siden av Louisa og skaper problemer for henne, Martin og lokalbefolkningen. Beboere begynner også å oppdage noe uvanlig med PC Penhale.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 304
programme.desc: Fru Wilson, den hypokondriske eieren av Wilson-hotellet, vier all sin oppmerksomhet til Martin, noe som fører til at Louisa blir sjalu.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 305
programme.desc: Paulines spilleavhengighet kommer endelig fram i lyset.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 306
programme.desc: En mystisk luftveisinfeksjon bryter ut i landsbyen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 307
programme.desc: På bryllupsdagen får brudepiken til Louisa konfetti i øyet; den lokale blomsterhandleren blir arrestert og blir tvunget til å stenge butikken sin.

programme.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
programme.desc: En ordfører får hjelp av en barndomsvenn til å arrangere byens juleinnsamling, mens hun setter i gang med å spleise ham med sin nære venninne.

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: To rivaliserende eiendomsmeglere blir tvunget til å samarbeide for å selge et spesielt hus, eid av en anerkjent botaniker og mistelteindyrker, før jul.

programme.title: The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: En ulykke fører til at Charlotte havner i koma, men ånden hennes er våken. I forkant av en avstemning om et eiendomsprosjekt må hun få byen og utbyggeren til å ombestemme seg uten at noen kan se eller høre henne.

programme.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
programme.desc: Ivy balanserer ferieforpliktelser, datteren og motstridende følelser til eksmannen, alt samtidig med at en mystisk skøyer skaper rabalder i Candy Cane Lane.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy selger sin avdøde tantes matsentral, Angel's Fare, til den lokale bedriftseieren Adam, men en frivillig som jobber der ønsker å arrangere en siste julemiddag.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: På julaften ønsker Becky at familien hennes virkelig skal høre henne. Alle tankene og frustrasjonene hennes renner ut når hun uforvarende begynner å fortelle alle hva hun egentlig tenker.

programme.title: Christmas Party Crashers
programme.desc: Når to bedragere møtes etter å ha krasjet den samme millionærens julefest, blir de enige om å jobbe sammen, uten å vite at de vil finne noe som er viktigere enn penger eller berømmelse: ekte kjærlighet.

programme.title: Back to Christmas
programme.desc: En kvinne reiser ett år tilbake i tid til julen før hennes brutte forlovelse og prøver å reparere det som gikk galt. Hun oppdager at dette er en større utfordrende oppgave enn hun trodde.

programme.title: Hotel for the Holidays
programme.desc: Samtidig som hotelldirektøren Georgia navigerer i romantiske forviklinger med kokken og en kjekk prins, får vi et innblikk i livet til andre gjester og ansatte.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Next Step
programme.desc: Det å bli venner igjen viser seg å være helt umulig for en, som pakker sakene sine. Chloe holder et show som Sam sent vil glemme. Grant liker seg godt på soverommet til jentene og Sophies søken etter en gutt bringer henne nærmere hjemmestedet.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Shag Pad Invasion
programme.desc: Geordienes hjemmefester er legendariske - drikke seg dritings, hooke, og det er alltid noen sannheter som kommer frem, men er det slutten på festen for Grant og Abbie? Sam ser rødt når Chloe koser med Alex, men Nathan ler sist og best.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Look Who's Back
programme.desc: Holly ankommer med storm - fra fortiden. Nathan tar med sin indre Peter Andre til klubben og Spphie tar ut sine flørteegenskaper. Begge blir varme og svette, men av helt forskjellige årsaker. Etter at Sam blir venner med Chloe, går han for langt?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Queen Nathan's Birthday
programme.desc: Holly er bekymret for Chloe, men Chloe vil bare gi Sam en lærepenge. Alle drar på en tur i outbacken til Nathans bursdag, men hva synes lokalbefolkningen om fire menn i drag? Sophie tar det med ro når hun tar med sin drag queen til sengs.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The New Geordie
programme.desc: Gjengen våkner i villmarken og kaster seg ut i lokale skikker som saueklipping og mat fra bushen. En kveld på den lokale strippebula fører til at Abbie får tips og Sophie går fullt inn for å få mannen sin. Tilbake i Goldie venter det en ny Geordie!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Sam Busts His Hand
programme.desc: Sophie og Alex våkner etter å ha fått avtalen i boks. Sophie er glad, men Alex tviler. Nathan ser rødt når Alex tar en avgjørelse og så er det igang. Sams hånd får ham på sykehus, så Chloe drukner sine sorger, og det skikkelig!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Pride Party
programme.desc: Gjengen feirer Pride som bare geordier kan med alle husfesters mor - og en overraskelsesgjest! Sophie ender i tårer og Chloe er ikke imponert over Alex. Sam kommer tilbake og Abbie og den nye fyren Adam nærmer seg hverandre.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Gotta Have Faith
programme.desc: Geordie-gjengen er tilbake på hjemmebane og klare for å skape mer leven enn noen gang. Denne gangen får de besøk av noen gamle kjenninger, noen nye ansikter, og venner og familie mens de gjør seg klare til å male byen rød igjen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordie Dinner Party
programme.desc: Chloe og Sam viser fram sitt nye hjem når de inviterer gjengen på innvielsesfest. Nathan vakler når han skjønner at han må jobbe på Scotts første jobb. Faith oppdager snart at ikke alt bare er en stor fest når hun støter sammen med Chloe.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Girls Trip
programme.desc: Sophie bestemmer at jentene trenger en sammensveisings-ferie i Blackpool, mens guttas forhold aldri har vært så ille. Faith snakker ut med Chloe, men det er ikke sikkert at hun husker særlig mye neste morgen!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Sophie And Sam Fall Out
programme.desc: Gjengen kunne ikke hatt det bedre etter turen til Blackpool, men det endrer seg når de er tilbake i by'n. Faith blir uvenner med Nathan og spenninger mellom Sam og Chloe renner over og gjør at de pakker kofferten.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: It's Snowing In Newcastle
programme.desc: Abbie og Adam sliter med vennskapet og Nathan føler seg sviktet av Chloe som setter kjæresten Sam, først. Faith føler seg omsider som én av gjengen, og Scott tar med gjengen på dykking i tank.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Benidorm Bound
programme.desc: Geordiene prøver seg på burlesk dans og inviterer venner på en spillkveld. Anna sender dem til Benidorm. Gjengen gjør furore på The strip, men Sophie slår Sam etter at han enda en gang kaller henne sjalu.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Nana Joins The Gang
programme.desc: Sophie ber om unnskyldning for å ha slått Sam og geordiene har en herlig dag i vannparken. Gjengen drar på klubb med Abbies bestemor, og det er akkurat det som trengs for å sveise familien sammen igjen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: A Double Return
programme.desc: Sophie mister munn og mæle når Alex fra Australia kommer på overraskelsesbesøk. Det er god stemning i huset når Holly kommer tilbake og tar med gjengen til Newcastle Pride for fest, drikking og dansing!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Holly Gets A Shock
programme.desc: Chloe tar med Sam på en hemmelig date som gjør at det går kaldt nedover ryggen hans. Alex må fornedre seg for Sophie, og Scotty T gjør livet pinlig for Holly da han tar med hennes ekskjæreste Kyle på jobb.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Letter
programme.desc: Sammi finner det 'anonyme' brevet fra Snooki og Jenni, og nå er det virkelig slutt - i hvert fall en stund. Mike, Vinny og Pauly har hendene fulle med fire jenter på én kveld.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Not So Shore
programme.desc: Det anonyme brevet skaper spenning mellom jentene, og det ender i slåsskamp. Etter enda en natt med Vinny avslører Snooki en ikke så lite kjent 'hemmelighet'.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Sleeping with the Enemy
programme.desc: Gjengen må takle konsekvensene av jentenes krangel. Angelina dater Jose fra klubben, og Jenni og Snooki kler seg i hjemmelagde beskyttelsesdrakter for å rydde opp før Snookis date.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: All in the Family
programme.desc: Mike truer med å fortelle Jose om Angelina og Vinny. Vinnys familie kommer på besøk. Og Vinny og Pauly finner drømmejentene, men en vil få knust hjertet sitt.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Dirty Pad
programme.desc: Angelina er i trøbbel når gjengen får vite at hun lå med Jose etter en natt med Vin. Men den siste dråpen kommer når Mike oppdager flere ubehageligheter på badet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Gone, Baby, Gone
programme.desc: Mike gjenforens med sin kanadiske skjønnhet, til stor underholdning for hele huset. Angelina forteller gjengen hva hun syns om dem, noe som gjør Snooki rasende og får begeret til å flyte over.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Girls Like That
programme.desc: Vinny velger mellom to grupper jenter. Siden Angelina er borte vil Snooki at hun og Jenni skal skvære opp med Sam. Gleden blir kortvarig for Snooki, når Mike blir stadig mer fiendtlig.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Deja Vu All Over Again
programme.desc: Alle er frustrerte over Mike - han får gjengen sparket ut av en klubben, får bilen tauet vekk, brenner nesten ned huset og svikter Pauly. To ganger.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Back into the Fold
programme.desc: Pauly og Vin har sine siste dater med Miami-jentene, mens Sam og Ron raskt havner i krangel. Jenni lager bråk mellom Pauly og Mike, og det blir en siste kveld full av drama i boblebadet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Back to the Shore
programme.desc: Gjengen er tilbake for enda en vill sommer på Jersey-kysten! Angelina er borte, og Snooki har med seg vennen Deena. Spenningen mellom jentene etter Miami eksploderer den første kvelden.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: It's Gonna Be an Interesting Summer
programme.sub-title: It's Gonna Be an Interesting Summer
programme.desc: Konflikten mellom Sammi og JWoww skaper spenning i huset. Ronnie og Sammi isolerer seg og går glipp av første familiemiddag. Men når Ronnie bestemmer seg for å henge med resten av gjengen, føler Sammi seg helt alene.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Where's the Beach
programme.desc: Sammi vil slutte fred med Snooki og Deena. JWoww møter eksen Roger. Snooki blir arrestert for drikking på offentlig sted.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Free Snooki
programme.desc: Snooki er deprimert etter å ha blitt arrestert, helt til hun treffer en ny gutt. Deena treffer Ronnies stuntmann. JWoww og Tom slår opp.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Drunk Punch Love
programme.desc: Ronnie og JWoww slutter fred, og Sammi slår til Ronnie. Vinny møter en jente med overlegen familie. Og Mike avslører Deenas lille hemmelighet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Should We Just Break Up?
programme.desc: Ronnies drikking gir smertefulle bivirkninger. Snooki treffer en gutt som kanskje eller kanskje ikke er forlovet. Pauly slutter fred med en gammel fiende.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Cabs Are Here!
programme.desc: Ronnie og Sammis stormfulle forhold er over. Ronnie ødelegger alt Sammi eier, og hun må bestemme seg for om hun skal forlate gjengen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Great Depression
programme.desc: Ronnie sliter etter at Sammi dro, og føler at han ikke har noen venner i huset. Jentene tar Sammis parti, guttene vet ikke hvordan de skal muntre ham opp. Mike legger an på Paulys ekskjæreste.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Kissing Cousins
programme.desc: Snookis sexfylte sommer hjemsøker henne. Mike drar den ultimate spøk mot Deena og Snooki, men de andre ler sist når Mike somler med å komme til middag.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: A Cheesy Situation
programme.desc: Sammis retur gjør Ronnie målløs. Snookis følelser for Vinny blir dypere. Mike møter en jente han mener lukter ost, men vet ikke at han blir kraftig lurt.

programme.title: Matlock: The Game Show
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the defense of popular game show host Dennis Blake who’s accused of the murder of his successful, yet despised mega-millionaire producer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Foursome
programme.desc: A brash multimillionaire, Ellis Blake is held in the slaying of Jeffrey Holden, a handsome, young man who intended to marry Ellis’ daughter – without his blessing or consent.

programme.title: Matlock: The Picture (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock’s search for evidence to prove his client innocent of killing her husband uncovers a ring of counterfeiters who will pay any price, including murder, to keep their secret. Ben’s investigation uncovers ties to the mob.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock’s faith in his ability as a top-notch attorney is completely eroded when he’s dismissed by a client and replaced by a younger lawyer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 2)
programme.desc: During his fishing trip, Matlock encounters the small, unfriendly town of Lone Pine as he attempts to solve the mysterious death of a young farmhand and uncover a town-wide coverup.

programme.title: Matlock: The Abduction
programme.desc: While attending a UCLA Law seminar, Matlock and Michelle end up in a dangerous dilemma. After giving Matlock inside information regarding an upcoming hit his former law school classmate is involved in a fatal hit and run.

programme.title: Matlock: Mr. Awesome
programme.desc: Matlock defends Anne Johnson, a single mother who’s been accused of murdering her recently estranged boyfriend.

programme.title: Matlock: The Evening News (Part 1)
programme.desc: A phony story is planted on the nightly news when a corrupt land developer pays off the on-air talent but when the producer fakes his own death, the anchorwoman unwittingly helps him along, never realizing it’s somebody else she killed.

programme.title: Matlock: The Evening News (Part 2)
programme.desc: Hired to defend an innocent newscaster, Matlock is baffled until evidence turns up that puts him on the trail of the real killer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Assassination (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock’s daughter’s surprise visit home is interrupted when a judge, on a Blue Ribbon panel investigating the assassination of the town Mayor, is accused of sexual assault and seeks Matlock’s counsel.

programme.title: Matlock: The Assassination (Part 2)
programme.desc: When his daughter is jailed for contempt Matlock takes over her case. Now it is up to him to uncover the truth behind a sinister cover-up that involves high government officials, including the Chief of Police, in a child pornography ring and a murder.

programme.title: Matlock: The Vacation (Part 1)
programme.desc: When Matlock and his daughter Leanne arrive at a seaside resort to plan their new law partnership, they discover the manager has been murdered.

programme.title: Matlock: The Vacation (Part 2)
programme.desc: While vacationing with his daughter, Matlock tries to solve the murder of the hotel manager at their seaside resort.

programme.title: Matlock: The Legacy (Part 2)
programme.desc: Young Brian Martell is accused of murdering a famous playwright – just as his father was charged with murdering the playwright’s father forty years ago! In untangling a web of secrets and adultery, Matlock and his father uncover the shocking truth.

programme.title: Matlock: The Ghost
programme.desc: A friend of Matlock’s, Mike Wilson, has been murdered and his wife has been accused of the crime.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.sub-title: "Charlie’s Angels" Reunion With Cameron Diaz & Lucy Liu, Adam Sandler
programme.desc: "The Drew Barrymore Show" kicks-off its premiere episode with a "Charlie’s Angels" reunion with Cameron Diaz and Lucy Liu. Drew also reunites with longtime friend / co-star Adam Sandler. Drew has a big surprise for a deserving family of essential workers.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.sub-title: Andrew Rannells, Jill Kargman, Weird Food Combos With TikTok Chef Eitan Bernath
programme.desc: Drew is joined by “The Boys in the Band” star Andrew Rannells. Plus, Drew’s ex-sister-in-law actress Jill Kargman helps celebrate the first day of October. Then, Drew taste tests some weird food combos with 18-year-old chef and TikTok star Eitan Bernath.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.sub-title: Jason Sudeikis, Sherri Shepherd & Kym Whitley, The Weekender
programme.desc: "Ted Lasso" actor Jason Sudeikis joins Drew. Plus, comedians Sherri Shepherd and Kym Whitley on their podcast "Two Funny Mamas". Then, Drew sends viewers into the weekend with a curated list of her favorite picks in "The Weekender."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Gloria Estefan, Emily Estefan, Lili Estefan, Luvvie Ajayi Jones in #ShareTheMicwithLuvvie.
programme.sub-title: Gloria Estefan, Emily Estefan, Lili Estefan, Luvvie Ajayi Jones in #ShareTheMicwithLuvvie.
programme.desc: Drew interviews Gloria Estefan, her daughter Emily and niece Lili Estefan. Drew also joins Luvvie Ajayi Jones to shine the spotlight on one of the special women in #ShareTheMicwithLuvvie.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Sharon Stone, Chef Carla Hall, Beauty Routines with Allure Magazine’s Editor In Chief
programme.sub-title: Sharon Stone, Chef Carla Hall, Beauty Routines with Allure Magazine’s Editor In Chief
programme.desc: "Ratched" star Sharon Stone joins Drew. Plus, "Halloween Baking Championship" Host and Judge Carla Hall shares one of her favorite foods with Drew. Drew discusses her morning and evening routine with Allure Magazine’s Editor in Chief Michelle Lee.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.sub-title: Henry Winkler, Nico Santos, Drew Gooder, Cooking with Chef Aaron Sanchez
programme.desc: Henry Winkler on his latest children’s book, "Lights, Camera, Danger!" "Superstore" star Nico Santos joins Drew. Drew shines a spotlight on 18-year-old hero Justin Galvin." Plus, Drew celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month cooking with Aaron Sanchez.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Hoda Kotb, America’s Most Haunted House, The Weekender
programme.sub-title: Hoda Kotb, America’s Most Haunted House, The Weekender
programme.desc: "Today" Co-Anchor Hoda Kotb joins Drew to discuss her new book. Drew goes inside one of America’s most Haunted Houses with the help of a medium. Then, Drew gives a curated list of her favorites in "The Weekender."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: “Drew’s D-Cluttering” Show, Marie Kondo, Rachael Ray
programme.sub-title: “Drew’s D-Cluttering” Show, Marie Kondo, Rachael Ray
programme.desc: It’s “Drew’s D-Cluttering” show! Drew is joined by tidying expert Marie Kondo who shares her tips for sparking joy. Then, Rachael Ray shares kitchen staples for a clutter-less kitchen. Plus, Drew surprises one single mom with a home office makeover.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Time Management Hour, 5-Min Meals with Chef Rocco DiSpirito
programme.sub-title: Time Management Hour, 5-Min Meals with Chef Rocco DiSpirito
programme.desc: It’s Drew’s time management hour! Time management expert Laura Vanderkam shares tips. A five-min meal with Chef Rocco DiSpirito. "The People’s Court" Judge Marilyn Milian and husband Judge John Schlesinger on balancing work and relationships effectively.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: “Queer Eye’s” Karamo Brown, Beauty In A Box, Halloween Tablescapes with Darcy Miller
programme.sub-title: “Queer Eye’s” Karamo Brown, Beauty In A Box, Halloween Tablescapes with Darcy Miller
programme.desc: “Queer Eye’s” Karamo Brown joins Drew. In Beauty in A Box, Drew surprises a viewer at home who is need of a quick makeup routine. Plus, celebrations expert Darcy Miller shares Halloween tablescapes to help your family celebrate the holiday this year.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Seth MacFarlane & Liz Gillies, Drew’s Surprise For Family Who Adopted 5 Siblings, The Weekender
programme.sub-title: Seth MacFarlane & Liz Gillies, Drew’s Surprise For Family Who Adopted 5 Siblings, The Weekender
programme.desc: Seth MacFarlane and Liz Gillies on their new album. Drew surprises Andi & Thomas Bonura, parents of three, who adopted five siblings after hearing they were separated in different foster homes. Drew gives a list of her favorite picks in “The Weekender.”

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Halloween Celebration with Adam Sandler, Pumpkin Blaze, Jill Kargman
programme.sub-title: Halloween Celebration with Adam Sandler, Pumpkin Blaze, Jill Kargman
programme.desc: Drew kicks-off her week-long Halloween celebration with Netflix’s “Hubie Halloween” star Adam Sandler. Then, actress Jill Kargman and Drew visit Pumpkin Blaze Long Island! Plus, Drew tackles dating at any age in her signature “Love Bug” segment.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: "The Witches" Star Stanley Tucci, "Hubie Halloween" Star Noah Schnapp
programme.sub-title: "The Witches" Star Stanley Tucci, "Hubie Halloween" Star Noah Schnapp
programme.desc: Drew continues the week-long Halloween celebration with "The Witches" star Stanley Tucci. Leo Kelly joins to make a mocktail. "Hubie Halloween" star Noah Schnapp stops by to chat. Plus, Design by Drew Scarrymore and the Drew Scarrymore Costume Challenge.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew’s Never Have I Ever Hour, First Date After Divorce
programme.sub-title: Drew’s Never Have I Ever Hour, First Date After Divorce
programme.desc: It’s Drew’s Never Have I Ever Hour! Drew helps a viewer get ready for her first date since her divorce. New foods with Eitan Bernath. Then, we follow a couple as they go sky diving for the first time! Plus bonus moments with actress Charlize Theron.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Dr. Phil, "Hubie Halloween" Star China Anne McClain, Drew’s News with Ross Matthews
programme.sub-title: Dr. Phil, "Hubie Halloween" Star China Anne McClain, Drew’s News with Ross Matthews
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares why it was important for him to produce his new docuseries "That Animal Rescue Show." Then, Halloween week continues with "Hubie Halloween" star China Anne McClain. Plus, Drew’s News with special guest Ross Matthews.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Anne Hathaway, "The Daily Show’s” Dulce Sloan
programme.sub-title: Anne Hathaway, "The Daily Show’s” Dulce Sloan

programme.sub-title: Drew’s Halloween Show! "Emily in Paris" Star Ashley Park

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 302
programme.desc: I dagens episode møter vi bl.a. Isabella, som fikk utført brystforstørring som 18-åring for å ligne Pamela Anderson, men som i dag sitter igjen med to steinharde kuler på brystkassen.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 104
programme.desc: Pernille får kick av å få utført plastisk kirurgi, men armene hennes er vansiret av store arr. Mille drømmer om at de feilopererte brystene hennes blir fiksa før bryllupet.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 205
programme.desc: I denne episoden møter vi bl.a. Dianne, som fikk fjernet brystene grunnet mistanke om kreft, men som nå lever alene fordi hun føler seg utilpass, og Anette, som fikk foretatt en hudoperasjon i utlandet.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 303
programme.desc: Doris var med i en alvorlig bussulykke og i dag sliter hun med ekstreme bivirkninger av en operasjon som egentlig skulle ha reddet utseendet hennes etter ulykken.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 601
programme.desc: Charlotte fikk fjernet brystimplantatene sine på grunn av komplikasjoner. Etter det fikk hun en protese for å kompensere for størrelsen på brystene, men protesen er både ubehagelig og upraktisk.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 106
programme.desc: Vi møter fire personer som har gjort plastikkirugi som har fått ødeleggende konsekvenser: blant annet Lone som lever i frykt for at implantatene hennes er kreftfremkallende.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 305
programme.desc: I dag møter vi bl.a. Jonna, som føler at magen hennes ligner et bombekrater etter en operasjon, og Christina, som har tre mislykkede operasjoner bak seg.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 703
programme.desc: Den tidligere burlesk-danseren Grethe måtte i 2011 fjerne begge brystene som en del av hennes behandling av brystkreft.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 101
programme.desc: I kveldens episode møter vi fire ofre for plastiskkirurgiske feiloperasjoner.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 501
programme.desc: Siden puberteten, har Tascha vært lei av sine asymmetriske bryster og har hatt en brystoperasjon. Men Tascha fikk ikke symmetrien hun drømte om, og i dag skammer hun seg over brystene.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 805
programme.desc: Som tenåring har Linette en skjev skillevegg i nesen som gir henne pustevansker. Som 21-åring får hun derfor tilbud om en neseoperasjon for å fikse problemet, men ender opp med en skjev nese.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 105
programme.desc: Sabine fant et tilbud på nettet, men måtte betale dyrt for å spare 50 prosent.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 608
programme.desc: I 2011 velger Sabina å ta en brystforstørrelsesoperasjon. Men allerede et par dager etter operasjonen oppdager hun at brystene hennes henger.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 202
programme.desc: I dagens episode møter vi bl.a. Pernille, som føler seg fanget i sitt eget hjem, og Linda, som er så hemmet av et arr på magen at hun møter opp tidlig på jobb for å unngå å skifte med andre.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 902
programme.desc: Etter en brystoperasjon har Samantha tunge, smertefulle bryster og et skrantende forhold.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 609
programme.desc: For 21 år siden havnet Allan i en voldsom sykkelulykke. Allan er merket for livet, og til tross for flere operasjoner sitter han igjen med arr i ansiktet.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 306
programme.desc: Vi møter Jeanette, som føler seg som en forsøkskanin etter en rekke mislykkede operasjoner. Maria måtte fjerne implantatene sine, og er nå uten bryster. Shahin har smerter etter en ansiktsløftning.

programme.title: Andromeda: Pitiless as the Sun
programme.desc: Andromeda svarer på et nødanrop når et lasteskip blir angrepet

programme.title: Andromeda: Siste samtale ved den ødelagte hammeren
programme.sub-title: Siste samtale ved den ødelagte hammeren
programme.desc: Mannskapet ser etter en mistet Commonwealth-leder som har skjult seg.

programme.title: Andromeda: Altfor menneskelig
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka og Trance går sammen med Rommie for å finne ut om et våpen som utvikles på en planet som mistro AI.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una Salus Victus
programme.desc: Andromeda har til oppgave å eskortere medisinske skip trygt gjennom Drago-Kazov-rommet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjemmebranner
programme.desc: En planet av Commonwealth-overlevende ledet av Dylans tidligere forlovede blir invitert til å bli med i det nye Commonwealth, men når de stemmer for ikke å bli med, blir Magog mistenkt for å ha spilt skittent.

programme.title: Andromeda: Inn i labyrinten
programme.desc: En avgrunnsagent prøver å lokke Harper til å bli med i Magog

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: Når de redder en ung prins fra et opprør som dreper resten av familien hans, blir Dylan og Tyr bedt om å være hans rådgivere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunker Hill
programme.desc: Dylan og hans nye Commonwealth-flåte tar på seg Drago-Kazov-flåten, men synes den er mye større enn forventet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-eggene i Harper begynner å klekkes, så teamet bygger en Tesseract-maskin

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava og raketter
programme.desc: Dylan overtar en turistpram i et forsøk på å unnslippe leiesoldater.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vær alle mine synder husket
programme.desc: En kroppsidentifikasjon går galt når det viser seg at Bekas tidligere mannskap ikke er død.

programme.title: Andromeda: Mayflies dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drift, men de blir snart til zombier som blir kontrollert av en bikube.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himmelen er nå tre
programme.desc: Motoren til skapelsen er i stand til å omskrive universet i henhold til eierens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må skaffe det før noen med mørke planer får det.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ting vi ikke kan endre
programme.desc: Et svart hull slår Dylan ut og sender ham inn i en alternativ virkelighet med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Fair Unknown
programme.desc: Mannskapet redder en av de tapt grunnleggerne av Commonwealth, men oppdager at hun kan være mer trøbbel enn hun er verdt.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dyrets mage
programme.desc: Et mytologisk rommonster prøver å spise Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djevelen
programme.desc: Dylan prøver å frigjøre en flåte med fangede skip, men flåten er ikke sikker på at den vil bli frigjort. AI-ene deres frykter at nye kapteiner vil slavebinde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Immaculate Perception
programme.desc: Genitter angriper Tyrs kone og koloni.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Interrupted
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was later found guilty in the slaying.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club, but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hell's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Kristine Fitzhugh failed to show up for her music class, her husband found her dead at the bottom of the stairs of their Palo Alto home. Further investigation reveals evidence of murder in the kitchen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Squire's Riches
programme.desc: Responding to a 2008 garage fire, Illinois emergency response discovered a man crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida mobile home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire. Michael heroically rescues his wife and infant son. A month later, his wife is found beaten to death in a bedroom of his parents' home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freeze Framed
programme.desc: In 2005, David Castor suffered a slow, agonizing death over a period of days. His wife maintained it was suicide, even though it was done with antifreeze.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Textbook Murder
programme.desc: Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé, Keyon Pittman. When police learned that Pittman was having affairs with other women, he became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Filtered Out
programme.desc: In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3
programme.desc: Teamet legger ut på en roadtrip på tvers av USA i biler kjøpt for under USD 1000, og takler en rekke utfordringer på veien.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Den nyeste Porche 911 blir satt på prøve. Teamet prøver også å få en Reliant Robin til å gå dit ingen trehjuler har gått forut.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Teamet drar på jakt etter Europas beste veier. De starter i Monaco og drar så til Italia, Liechtenstein og Sveits.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Teamet prøver å krysse den engelske kanal i amfibiebiler, tester en Porsche 911 mot en Audi R8, og Jools Holland er ukens gjest.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Teamet sammenligner måter å krysse London på i rushtiden. I tillegg blir en Caparo T1 og en Aston Martin V8 Vantage cabriolet evaluert.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Det første Top Gear Bobil Grand Prix blir en braksuksess og den nye Honda Civic Type-R testes for å se om den er like god som originalen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6
programme.desc: Top Gear-teamet blir fuktige i blikket over klassiske britiske biler og Jennifer Saunders er ukens stjerne i billigbilen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 7
programme.desc: Lewis Hamilton besøker Top Gear-banen, og Jeremy og James besøker National Motor Museum for å finne den virkelige opprinnelsen til den moderne bilen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 8
programme.desc: Teamet deltar i det 24 timer lange billøpet Britcar. De tester også en Daihatsu Materia mot en Ascari A1+, og konkurrerer mot BMX-syklister.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 9
programme.desc: Richard forvandler en G-Wiz elektrisk bil til en fjernkontrollert leke, James tester en Jaguar XF saloon, og David Tennant er ukens gjest.

programme.desc: Storbritannias fremste motorshow, med utfordringer, vurderinger og kjendisgjester.

programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case

programme.sub-title: Four Lovers For One Crime: The Joël Deprez Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Ordeal of Schoolgirl (Perrais case)
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Ordeal of Schoolgirl (Perrais case)
programme.desc: Laetitia Perrais, 18, a trainee hotel waitress, vanishes after evening service.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle
programme.sub-title: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle
programme.desc: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and –an extra sordid detail – a devil mask is found next to her body.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.sub-title: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.sub-title: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Willy Pomonti Case
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
programme.sub-title: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
programme.desc: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Adeline Piet Case
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! What has happened to Adeline Piet?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.sub-title: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Predator
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

programme.title: 48 Hours: Who Killed the Beauty Queen?
programme.desc: In 2005, a college student and aspiring beauty queen Nona Dirksmeyer was found murdered inside her apartment. Police believed Nona's boyfriend flew into a murderous rage when he discovered a condom wrapper on her kitchen counter.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Peace, Love and Murder
programme.desc: A report on the murder of housewife Toni Heartsong, killed in her Jupiter, Florida home on in 2000. Her husband was initially eliminated as a possible suspect, but in 2006, new DNA technology revealed the presence of his blood under Toni's thumbnail.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Vegas Heat
programme.desc: A report on the 2005 discovery of the charred corpse of a young woman, found in a burned-out car on a Las Vegas desert road. The car was registered to Kelly Ryan, a fitness champion who is married to Craig Titus, a Mr. Olympia competitor.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Peter Chadwick: Caught
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Betrayal
programme.desc: A report on the September 3, 2006 disappearance of Nina Reiser, a Russian doctor who had married Hans Reiser, an American computer whiz. Their marriage began to fall apart and Nina began an affair with Sean Sturgeon, Hans' best friend.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Jayme Closs: Hometown Hero
programme.desc: Jayme Closs' story captured the world's hearts when she disappeared from her family's home in Barron, Wisconsin on October 15, 2018. She fled her captor 88 days later.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Troubling Case Against Kevin Cooper
programme.sub-title: The Troubling Case Against Kevin Cooper
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Screenplay for Murder
programme.desc: A report on Canadian filmmaker Mark Twitchell, whose obsession with the Showtime television series "Dexter" turned to reality and led to murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Killer Defense
programme.desc: A report on the 2007 murder of Jennifer Turner, married but separated from Dr. Kirk Turner, due to his infidelities with the family banker, Tondja Colvin. Jennifer had filed for divorce and also brought an alienation of affection suit against Tondja.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Live to Tell: The Railroad Killer
programme.sub-title: Live to Tell: The Railroad Killer
programme.desc: A report on the August 29, 1997 attack on two University of Kentucky students as they walked along the railroad tracks in Lexington, Kentucky.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Ransom
programme.desc: A report on the mysterious 2008 disappearance of Robert Wiles, the son of millionaire business owner Tom Wiles, who received an e-mail ransom note demanding $750,000 for the safe return of the 26-year-old.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Hunter

programme.title: 48 Hours: Catch Her If You Can

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Mind For Murder

programme.title: 48 Hours: Addicted to Love

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: En uvanlig spion utfører en hemmelig oppdrag under andre verdenskrig, der virkelighet og bedrag konfronteres i en intens kamp mot fienden.

programme.title: Down Terrace
programme.desc: Etter å ha sonet fengsel for en mystisk forbrytelse, slipper Bill og Karl seg ut av fengselet og blir opptatt av å finne ut hvem som leverte dem til politiet. På toppen av det, er "familiebedriften" på steinene

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: I 2009 oppdaget NASA muligheten for fremmed liv innenfor vårt solsystem. En sonde ble skutt opp for å samle inn prøver fra en av Jupiters måner, Europa, men krasjet på tilbaketuren over Mellom-Amerika.

programme.title: Rough Stuff
programme.desc: En gruppe aktivister vil lage en film for å avdekke overtramp hos et stort gruveselskap, og de inngår en avtale med noen folk som lever utenfor loven, i Australias ødemark. Spenningen stiger når det viser seg at begge gruppene er på hver sin skattejakt.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerende fortelling om basketballtrener Ken Carter, som fikk både ris og ros da han skapte overskrifter med å sette hele sitt ubeseirede lag på benken på grunn av dårlige akademiske prestasjoner.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: I disse sammenflettede historiene prøver et univers av usannsynlige og motvillige helter å gjøre det rette i en by som nekter å bry seg.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Bud Spencer er Banana Joe, en vennlig kjempe av en banandyrker som bor i en liten Søramerikansk by. Det går livet sin vante gang helt til et stort selskap vil ta over bananplantasjen og sette Joe i fengsel.

programme.title: Skurker og banditter
programme.desc: Tony Roma er tidenes sleipeste gigolo, en skøyer som tar det meste på sparket, spesialisert på å rappe rike husmødres diamanter. Til slutt kobles den hemmelige politimannen Parker inn for endelig å få fakket gigoloen.

programme.title: Jo mere vi er sammen
programme.desc: Løytnant Firpo har som hemmelig oppdrag å bekjempe et gambling-syndikat på USA's østkyst. Hans halvbror Charlie er en forhenværende gambler som kjenner alle knepe. Han går motvillig med på å hjelpe Johnny, og sammen renser de opp i Miamis underverden.

programme.title: Trinity slår til igjen
programme.desc: Verdens mest populære spaghetti-helter, Terence Hill og Bud Spencer, ender denne gangen opp som tapre redningsmenn - mot sin vilje.

programme.title: Miami Supercops
programme.desc: I Miami Supercops spiller heltene våre to modige forbryterjegere på sporet av $20 millioner dollar som ble stjålet under et tyveri noen år tidligere.

programme.title: Fire never i Rio
programme.desc: De rike fetterne Antonio og Sebastiano Coimbra er to brasilianske mangemillionærer som lever i frykt for yrkesmordere. Derfor ansetter de to dobbeltgjengere, Greg Wonder som er en kriminelt belastet saxofonspiller, og stuntmannen Eliot Vance.

programme.title: Sammen tar vi prisen
programme.desc: Det blir action når det blir gjensyn med de actionkomikerne Terence Hill og Bud Spencer. Denne gangen spiller Hill en gjeldstynget gambler som finner et skattekart og sniker seg med en båt for å komme seg til en sydhavsøy der skatten skal være begravd.

programme.title: Supersnooper
programme.desc: Terence Hill er den nyutdannede politimannen Dave Speed, som skal innkassere en parkeringsbot langt ute i ødemarken. Desverre er dette også steder hvor forsvaret foretar topphemmelige prøvesprengninger med atomvåpen.

programme.title: Um Anjo em Nossas Vidas
programme.desc: Quando um criminoso insensível e doente cruza o caminho de uma menina cheia de fé, uma segunda chance surge para tocar o coração durante a temporada de festas.

programme.title: Separação e Reencontro
programme.desc: Separados após o divórcio e sem qualquer contato por 12 anos, pai e filha se reencontram para uma longa viagem cruzando o país. A jornada se torna mais complicada do que eles poderiam imaginar.

programme.title: Epiphany Amor e Perdão
programme.desc: Uma jovem luta para criar um relacionamento com o pai após a morte da tia que a criou

programme.title: Ester - A Rainha da Pérsia
programme.desc: Depois da conquista da Babilônia, a Pérsia torna-se um imenso Império. A nova lei instaurada dentro do reinado persa, que legaliza a perseguição e execução do povo judeu, faz com que Esther revele sua verdadeira origem.

programme.title: José, O Pai de Jesus: Coleção Bíblia Sagrada
programme.desc: O povo de Jerusalém está sofrendo sob o reinado de HERODES, e espera ser libertado dos ocupantes romanos pelo Messias cuja chegada está perto de acontecer.

programme.title: Davi e Golias
